issue.description:
ADR-004 requires a pinned MSRV verification lane in bead-rs-ci (`cargo +1.85 check --all-targets`) so the declared floor is tested on every run instead of asserted, with drift between the lane's toolchain and the manifest's `rust-version` failing CI — 'not a doc nit'. No open bead tracks this lane. Add the lane to the CI template (the template change lands via declarative-config with this repo's bead owning the deployment), and add a repo-side check asserting the lane's pinned toolchain equals `Cargo.toml`'s `rust-version` so future MSRV bumps cannot silently untest the floor.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Pin the bead-rs-ci MSRV lane to the manifest's declared rust-version (ADR-004)
